## Summary

Comfortable owning features across the entire stack: database schema design, REST API development, third-party service integration, and rendering strategy on the frontend. Started on the frontend (React/Next.js/Tailwind) and has spent the last stretch of his career going deeper on the backend — Go, distributed systems, databases — driven by wanting to know how things work underneath, not just that they work. Has led small teams, run code reviews, and driven architectural decisions on both client and product work. B.Sc. in Computer Science and Engineering, BGC Trust University, Chattogram, Bangladesh.

## How he works (philosophy)

A system isn't done when it works — it's done when it survives real traffic, bad input, and 3AM failures. That shows up as a preference for boring, correct infrastructure over clever fragility: atomic release gates instead of hoping a deploy lands cleanly, `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED` instead of pulling in a broker, backoff written directly into SQL instead of a fragile heartbeat. Off the clock: travel and astronomy.

Owned the review and download pages end to end; fixed a responsive layout bug with a CSS grid auto-fit pattern; fixed a keyboard focus-visibility issue; improved code splitting and lazy loading to cut initial load weight. ## Projects

### Frontend & full-stack

- [Narrative Guard](https://narrative-guard.vercel.app/) ([source](https://github.com/PratikDev/narrative-guard)) — Workspace-based brand governance platform. Three-tier role model (owner/admin/member) enforced server-side, per-brand RAG namespaces for workspace isolation, invite tokens stored as hashes, scheduled Convex actions for async audit processing. Tech: Next.js, TypeScript, Convex, Convex Auth, Google Gemini, RAG, shadcn/ui.
- [Roadmap App](https://bitcode-roadmap-app.vercel.app/) ([source](https://github.com/PratikDev/roadmap-app)) — Full-stack app with SSR, authentication, a REST API, upvoting, and commenting. Tech: Next.js, TypeScript, Drizzle ORM, PostgreSQL, Vercel.
- [Kar Communication](https://www.karcommunication.com/) — Animated landing page for an IT solutions company with React Query powering dynamic content sections. Tech: Next.js, TypeScript, shadcn/ui, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Firebase, React Query.
- [HWC Landing Page](https://software.helloworldbd.com/) — Company SSR landing page focused on responsive layout and Lighthouse-optimized performance via the Next.js Metadata API. Tech: Next.js, TypeScript, shadcn/ui, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Zod.
- [Bombus](https://bombus-no.vercel.app/) — Landing page for a Norwegian company, centered on Framer Motion animation work. Tech: Next.js, TypeScript, shadcn/ui, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Zod.

### Backend & systems

- [Result Lookup](https://github.com/PratikDev/result-lookup) — High-throughput exam-result publishing system in Go, simulating Bangladesh's SSC result infrastructure serving 2M results. Pre-serialized JSON into Redis ahead of release time behind a publish-gate flag for atomic release, with cursor-based batch seeding and SCAN-based count verification before the gate flip. ~32k RPS peak with zero errors across a 615,000-request load test, p99 under 105ms at 1,000 concurrent connections, backed by a PostgreSQL fallback with connection limiting. Two-binary architecture (cmd/api, cmd/precompute), handler tests via miniredis. Tech: Go, PostgreSQL, Redis, pgx/v5, Docker, golang-migrate, slog.
- [URL Health Checker](https://github.com/PratikDev/url-health-checker) — Async job queue, two-binary architecture (cmd/api, cmd/worker), workers claim jobs via `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED`. Exponential backoff written directly in SQL, atomic with status updates; staleness threshold for stale-job recovery instead of a heartbeat, avoiding a race condition on bounded-duration jobs. Graceful shutdown via `signal.NotifyContext`; integration tests against real PostgreSQL, unit tests via `httptest.NewServer`. Tech: Go, PostgreSQL, pgx/v5, Docker, golang-migrate, slog.
- [URL Shortener API](https://url-shortener-api-xiyp.onrender.com) ([source](https://github.com/PratikDev/url-shortener-api)) — Per-IP token-bucket rate limiter using a mutex-protected generic SafeMap, retry-on-conflict short-code generation instead of pre-checking. Non-root Docker user, multi-stage build, integration tests against real PostgreSQL, schema loaded via `//go:embed`. Deployed on Render with managed PostgreSQL. Tech: Go, PostgreSQL, pgx/v5, Docker, golang-migrate, slog.
- [Spud](https://github.com/PratikDev/spud) — Discord bot for small-team task coordination: LLM-powered duplicate-task detection and scope-drift detection via GitHub branch comparison (Gemini through the Vercel AI SDK). HMAC-SHA256 webhook verification on every GitHub push, a permission model (team lead vs. server admin) enforced in application code, tasks auto-closed on PR merge. Tech: TypeScript, Bun, discord.js, SQLite, Gemini, Vercel AI SDK, Docker.
- [URL Scraper](https://github.com/PratikDev/url-scrapper) — CLI tool using goroutines and mutex-based deduplication for concurrent URL scraping. Tech: Go. (learning project)
- [The Super Tiny Compiler](https://github.com/pratikdev/the-super-tiny-compiler-go) — Small compiler covering tokenizing, parsing, and AST transformation. Tech: Go. (learning project)
